text: - Deload periods that reduce intensity or volume, or both, should be integrated into periodized programs to facilitate rejuvenation and recovery. A 3:1 ratio (in weeks) of training and deloading is a good guideline to use as a starting point. Modifications should then be made depending on individual response.
book: Science and Development of Muscle Hypertrophy
chapter: Chapter 8: Program Design for Maximal Hypertrophy
